notes:
Inbound SMB lead from product contact (CTO). Trying to add conversational assistant to creative project management tool. Core ask: low latency for chat in EU + NA. Signed up self-serve, ran quick prototype against default region (us-central) and saw EU user complaints.

- 2026-03-03: AE intro email + asked for sample requests + timestamps. Provided request_id examples.
- 2026-03-05: Call (ff_20260305_neoncanvas_8792) with CTO + lead engineer. Demonstrated p95 spikes ~700-900ms from EU when routed to us-central.
- 2026-03-06: SE (Priya) suggested region switch to eu-west and enabling streaming + lower client-side timeout (10s -> 5s) for perceived snappiness; also suggested prefix caching and shorter prompt guidance. Shared quick checklist: prefer eu-west for EU users; enable streaming; use token limit 1024 for interactive flows; trim system messages; set client retry backoff.
- 2026-03-08: Customer ran eu-west A/B test (small sample) — median improved but p95 still ~380ms with cold-starts. Observed improvement when model warmed (prefix caching) and with shorter prompts.
- 2026-03-10: Provided sample SDK config snippet and recommended timeouts + explainers (drive link).
- 2026-03-12: Follow-up call scheduled; customer wants concrete perf guidance they can hand to frontend team.
Concise technical notes: prefer regional endpoint nearest users; enable streaming + smaller first-token timeout to show partial content; reduce system message and combine instructions into fewer tokens; remove large-context embeddings on every request (use cached embedding ids). For bursts: suggest client-side queuing + per-user rate limit to avoid spikes that push requests to cold instances.
Quote from CTO: "We want chat to feel instantaneous — users abandon if reply lags >1s."
Next immediate actions: run controlled region comparison (us-central vs eu-west) with identical payloads (timestamps + request ids), capture p50/p95/p99, and produce short perf playbook (3 items) for their frontend devs. Blockers: need permission for deeper logs (customer to share API request ids for 10 slow examples), unsure on budget to enable eu-west for production.
